meta.title: PoE 2 desecration (bones, Well of Souls, desecrated mods)

confidence_legend.high: game files or official patch notes
confidence_legend.medium: several community sources agree / strong inference from data
confidence_legend.low: one source, or our own reading of an unnamed data column

rules.rule: Bones only work on Rare items of their item classes.
An item can hold at most 1 Desecrated mod (revealed or not); "This item already has a Desecrated Modifier."
No open affix needed: if modifiers are full a random modifier is removed and the unrevealed mod added.
The unrevealed mod is a Desecrated Prefix or Desecrated Suffix (shown on the item); the side is random unless Sinistral/Dextral Necromancy is used, and the reveal only offers mods of that side.
Body Armour, Helmet, Gloves, Boots, Shield and Buckler have no exclusive desecrated prefixes. The reveal can still offer normal prefixes (medium).
Gnawed bones: item level 64 or lower. All exclusive lineage mods are level 65, so Gnawed bones can only reveal normal mods.
Ancient bones: Minimum Modifier Level 40 (offered mods are level 40+, except a mod type that has no tier that high keeps its best tier); cannot be used below item level 40.
Since 0.5.0 (25/5/26 update) desecrated mods no longer count as crafted mods.
An item in the Well of Souls slot cannot be modified.
Essence of the Abyss adds "Mark of the Abyssal Lord"; desecrating that item always removes the Mark and adds a higher-tier Unrevealed mod.
Recombination can carry at most one Desecrated mod.
Preserved Cranium on jewels: rising chance to destroy the jewel each time (Unstable Desecration). Heart of the Well / Time-Lost style jewels say "Can be Desecrated N Times".

reveal_model.where: Well of Souls (Act 2 Abyss hub; travel via the world map pin)
reveal_model.side: fixed by the unrevealed mod (prefix or suffix)
option_draw: For each of the 3 options: with probability exclusive_option_chance (bone field; 0.08 for Preserved/Ancient) draw from the Abyss-exclusive pool for that item class and side, else from the item's normal mod pool (same side, item level, bone minimum modifier level).
Normal-pool draws use the normal spawn weights (the same as Exalted Orbs). Real weights are not in the game files; the app uses equal weights as elsewhere.
Exclusive-pool draws: all exclusive mods have flat weight 1 in the data, so uniform among the eligible ones.
Options are distinct mod groups (assumed, like other multi-mod draws), and none may share a group with a mod already on the item.
Lineage omen (Weapon/Jewellery): at least 1 option is from that lineage.
Altered Collarbone adds the breach_desecration tag, so its otherworldly (Genesis) mods can be drawn; their chance is not published.
Preserved Vertebrae (exclusive chance 1.0): options are always desecrated waystone mods.

confidence.exclusive_chance_0.08: low (our reading of an unnamed column)

occupies_affix.note: shown as "Desecrated Prefix/Suffix"; counts toward the 3/3 limit

chaos_annul_remove_it.note: it is a mod like any other; Whittling treats it as level 1; Omen of Light targets it

exalt_divine_work.note: Exalt can fill other free slots; Divine has no values to reroll on an unrevealed mod (low)

vaal.note: Putrefaction corrupts with unrevealed mods still revealable, which suggests corrupted items can still be revealed

reveal: nothing (free at the Well of Souls)
remove_desecrated: Orb of Annulment + Omen of Light
or Chaos Orb + Omen of Whittling (unrevealed only)

omens.name: Omen of Abyssal Echoes
omens.description:
While this item is active in your inventory the next time you
reveal Desecrated modifiers you can reroll the options once
omens.notes: Rerolls the whole set of options once; the first set cannot be taken back (guides, medium). Must be active before you press Reveal.
omens.confidence: high (effect) / medium (all 3 rerolled, no going back)

omens.name: Omen of the Sovereign
omens.description:
While this item is active in your inventory your next
Weapon or Jewellery Desecration attempt will guarantee a random Ulaman modifier
omens.applies_to: Weapon, Quiver, Amulet, Ring, Belt (Jawbone / Collarbone, Preserved or Ancient)
omens.notes: Guarantees at least one Ulaman option. Whether all 3 options become Ulaman is not published (low).
omens.confidence: high (text) / low (how many of the 3 options)

omens.name: Omen of Putrefaction
omens.description:
While this item is active in your inventory your next
Desecration attempt will replace all modifiers on the item
creating an item with up to 6 Unrevealed modifiers and Corrupting the item
omens.notes: All mods are replaced by up to 6 Unrevealed Desecrated mods and the item becomes Corrupted. Each is then revealed at the Well. A gamble for finished-item lottery, not a deterministic craft.
omens.confidence: high (text) / medium (each of the 6 revealed separately)

omens.name: Omen of Light
omens.description:
While this item is active in your inventory your next
Orb of Annulment will remove only Desecrated modifiers
omens.notes: Next Orb of Annulment removes only the Desecrated mod (items hold at most one, so it removes exactly that mod). Removing a still-unrevealed mod this way is likely but not confirmed (low).

omens.name: Omen of Sinistral Necromancy
omens.description:
While this item is active in your inventory your next
Desecration attempt will add only prefix modifiers
omens.notes: The unrevealed mod is a prefix. On a full item the removed mod is then a prefix too (medium: inferred, not stated).

omens.name: Omen of Dextral Necromancy
omens.description:
While this item is active in your inventory your next
Desecration attempt will add only suffix modifiers
omens.notes: The unrevealed mod is a suffix.

omens.name: Omen of Whittling
omens.description: Next Chaos Orb removes the lowest level modifier
omens.notes: An Unrevealed Desecrated mod counts as level 1, so Whittling + Chaos removes it (0.3.1 made Whittling highlight it). Useful to undo a bad desecration.

patch_history.change: Abyss league: bones, Well of Souls, desecrated mods, 15 omens
Whittling highlights desecrated mods; Unstable Desecration keyword; Well shows more detail
Abyss in the core game; Preserved Vertebrae no longer drop; a desecrated movement-penalty mod removed; staff ailment-magnitude mod buffed
Instant-leech desecrated mods can no longer roll; Abyss omens only drop in level 65+ areas; "of Union" waystone mod disabled; desecrated mods no longer count as crafted, limit 1 per item

keywords.Abyssalify:
Desecrating an item adds an Unrevealed Desecrated modifier. If modifiers are full then a random modifier is also removed. These modifiers can be revealed at the Well of Souls.

Items with Desecrated Modifiers cannot be Desecrated again.
keywords.UnstableDesecration: This item can be Desecrated using the Preserved Cranium currency item. There is an increasing chance for it to be destroyed each time it is Desecrated.
keywords.MarkofAbyssalLord: Desecrating an item with the Mark of the Abyssal Lord modifier always removes that modifier, replacing it with an Unrevealed Desecrated modifier of a higher tier.
keywords.BetterCurrencyMinimumLevel: Added random Modifiers are at least this level or higher, except if a specific Modifier type would be excluded entirely from being able to roll. Currency with a Minimum Modifier Level cannot be used on items with an item level below the Minimum Modifier Level.
keywords.CurrencyMaximumItemLevel: You cannot use this currency on items above this level.
keywords.AbyssalDepths:
Abyssal Depths are an underground dungeon sometimes found when completing the final Abyss in the area.

The Abyssal Depths contains many Abyssal monsters and all Rare monsters will have an Abyssal Modifier.
At the end of the Abyssal Depths is a more powerful Rare with both a Lichborn Modifier and an Abyssal Modifier. Defeating this Rare will unlock valuable chests nearby.

The chests at the end of the Abyssal Depths can also drop pieces of Preserved Bone, but also can rarely drop additional exclusive Omens and Lineage Supports.

At higher levels the Abyssal Depths can lead to powerful Boss Fights.
keywords.ContainsAbyss:
An Abyss is a pit which leads deep underground with multiple fissures branching from it. Any monsters spawned near an Abyss will be weakened by it.
Defeating these weakened monsters will cause the fissures to close.
Once the fissures have closed all the way to the pit, the pit will activate and spawn a large number of Abyssal monsters. Defeating these monsters will close the pit. 

Each closed pit has a chance to spawn an Abyssal Trove which can grant pieces of Preserved Bone to craft onto your Items. The final Abyss in the area has a chance to instead open an underground dungeon called an Abyssal Depths.

There are three separate groups of Abyssal Monsters: the Lightless, the Blackblooded and the Legion of the Pit, each area generally contains one of these groups.
The rarity of the monsters spawned depends on the rarity of the slain weakened monsters and the emerging Abyssal will steal some or all of the modifiers from them.
Any of the modifiers stolen by Rare Abyssal can be upgraded to Abyssal Modifiers.
